chunks: Which of the favours of your Lord will you then deny?
ai.seo_question: What does the phrase 'Which of the favours of your Lord will you deny?' mean in the Quran?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this refrain is interpreted as a dual address to humans and jinn, emphasizing the infinite nature of divine favors that defy complete enumeration. It serves as a rhetorical device to provoke self-reflection, urging the creation to acknowledge their dependence on Allah amidst the overwhelming evidence of His mercy.
